articles.title: Navigating RERA & Property Title Due Diligence: A Buyer’s Practical Handbook
articles.excerpt: Key legal documentation steps every property buyer in India must verify before signing sale agreements or disbursing token advances.
articles.content:
Purchasing residential or commercial real estate requires an informed legal framework. Under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA), buyers benefit from strict disclosure norms, yet practical verification remains essential.

### 1. Title Search & Encumbrance Certificate
Always ensure an independent title verification spanning a minimum of 30 years is conducted by an experienced real estate advocate. An Encumbrance Certificate (EC) issued by the Sub-Registrar's Office confirms that the property is unencumbered by mortgages or court attachments.

### 2. Sanctioned Architectural Plans & Approvals
Cross-examine the sanctioned layout plan approved by the municipal corporation or local town planning development authority against the actual site construction. Any deviation beyond permissible setback or FAR limits poses compliance hazards.

### 3. Escrow Account Transparency
For under-construction projects, verify that the builder receives payments in the mandated 70% project escrow bank account designated on the state RERA portal. This guarantees capital allocation strictly for project execution.

articles.title: Prime Residential Market Outlook: Capital Appreciation & Rental Yield Benchmarks
articles.excerpt: An analysis of high-end property transaction volumes, infrastructure multipliers, and inflation-hedging qualities across major urban centers.
articles.content:
The prime residential segment continues to demonstrate resilient structural demand driven by end-user upgrades, NRIs seeking portfolio repatriation, and expanding wealth creation in technology and financial services.

### Quality Over Volume
Discerning purchasers have increasingly consolidated demand toward Grade-A corporate developers with pristine delivery track records. Premium properties located along high-speed transit arteries have seen consistent 9-14% annual capital appreciation.

### Rental Yield Realities
While traditional residential rental yields in India historically hovered near 2.5% to 3.2%, modern fully managed and luxury furnished apartments in tech-adjacent nodes now command 4.2% to 5.1% gross rental yields, making them compelling additions to wealth portfolios.

articles.title: Commercial Office Leasing: Essential Clauses for High-Growth Companies
articles.excerpt: Understanding lock-in periods, CAM reconciliation, power backup allocations, and fit-out rent-free periods before executing commercial leases.
articles.content:
Securing a commercial headquarters requires aligning business expansion timelines with lease terms.

### 1. Lock-in & Termination Provisions
Examine the mutual lock-in period. High-growth enterprises should negotiate early exit flexibility upon paying a predetermined notice fee rather than risking open-ended penalty damages.

### 2. Common Area Maintenance (CAM) Transparency
Scrutinize CAM charges. Demand clarity on what services are covered, whether HVAC electrical consumption is separately metered, and mandate annual CAM audit rights for occupants.
